title: A Multimodal, Multilingual, and Multidimensional Pipeline for Fine-grained Crowdsourcing Earthquake Damage Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating multimodal large language models' performance in assessing earthquake damage from social media posts across different languages (English for the 2019 Ridgecrest earthquake and Japanese for the 2021 Fukushima earthquake) by comparing their predictions to ground-truth seismic intensity data.

Analyzing the spatial sensitivity of model estimations by correlating predicted damage levels with epicentral distance, revealing that model performance and damage capturing are shaped by spatial disparities and population density (e.g., performing better in densely populated urban areas).
